backdrop.webp.prompt: Paint a finished wide background for a Pokémon fan game's research lab screen, in exactly the same painting style, light and palette as the reference image (painterly anime, bright clean daylight, saturated but soft colours, cel-shaded planes). Interior of a cosy seaside Pokémon research laboratory seen straight on from the front at standing height, a single room. Composition in three clear vertical thirds with calm floor in front: LEFT THIRD: a tall wooden bookshelf filled with coloured research binders and folders with plain spines, a rolling ladder, a few rolled maps. CENTRE THIRD: a large lab workbench with brass instruments, glass flasks with teal liquid, a microscope, a small Poké Ball incubator machine with dials, and a wooden drawer cabinet underneath; a big window behind it shows the blue sea and sky. RIGHT THIRD: a wall-mounted glass display case with a dark navy velvet lining holding eight empty round badge slots in two rows of four, above a small wooden cabinet with a potted plant. The top 12% of the image is a quiet plain wall and ceiling beam; the bottom 15% is a plain light wooden floor with almost no detail. Warm, tidy, inviting. No people, no Pokémon, no text, letters, numbers or writing anywhere, no UI, no frame, no vignette.
